title: LonghornPHP 2026
content: Longhorn PHP is back for 2026! The schedule is now live, and tickets are on sale! The conference will be held in Austin, Texas, and will start with an optional tutorial day on Thursday, October 15, followed by a full day of talks, keynotes, open spaces and more, on Friday, October 16. , with Early Bird pricing available through end of day September 16th.Our full schedule is available now
author: PHP.net news & announcements
